Execute TokenRefund; measure quote-vault delta, base-vault delta (if any), refund destination binding (stored field vs attacker-substituted), mint binding, token-program pinning, protocol-vault delta, attacker delta. Record exact arithmetic (not just gate result).

fixtures.alternativeSource: The single-field differential controls (BBS3-diff-*) already prove the gate; this corroboration is optional and would only confirm the result, not change it.

fixtures.notes: This fixture gap does NOT change the decision. The gate is already decided by the differential control.
